title: Data Archivist
note: Subject v2.0. Each script runs in an empty temporary folder with the fixtures we create (ancient_fragment.txt, chmod 000 / 444 files), nothing in your project is touched. The frame (---, blank lines, contents, the # transform) is checked line by line; messages may be reworded (subject 3.2) as long as the essential info is there: a reworded line is a warning, not a failure. Every file you open must be closed, errors must not crash the script. Source: authorized builtins and the sys / typing / file methods of each 'Authorized:' line (warning), imports sys / typing only (none in ex3), no 'with' before ex3, 'with' required in ex3, input() forbidden in ex2, secure_archive(name, action=..., content=...), type hints, flake8, mypy.
